muse.browsing.description: State shown while the user is browsing non-chat pages.

muse.browsingMuse.description: Displayed when the user is on a Muse page that has no specific string.

muse.chatting.description: Displayed while the user is in a chat with Muse.

muse.chattingWithMuse.description: Displayed as the details when the chat title is not shown.

muse.generatingResponse.description: Displayed while Muse is generating a response.

muse.paused.description: Displayed when podcast or media playback is paused.

muse.playing.description: Displayed when podcast or media playback is playing.

muse.podcast.description: Fallback title shown for podcast playback without a title.

muse.searching.description: Displayed while the quick search palette is open.

muse.typing.description: Displayed while the user has unsubmitted text in the chat input.

muse.video.description: Fallback title shown for video playback without a title.

muse.viewingArtifacts.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the artifacts library.

muse.viewingDocuments.description: Displayed when the user is viewing documents in the library.

muse.viewingFeed.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the feed.

muse.viewingGoals.description: Displayed when the user is viewing their goals.

muse.viewingIdeas.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the ideas page.

muse.viewingImages.description: Displayed when the user is viewing images in the media library.

muse.viewingLibrary.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the library.

muse.viewingMedia.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the media library.

muse.viewingPodcasts.description: Displayed when the user is viewing podcasts in the library.

muse.viewingVideo.description: Displayed when the user is viewing a video in the media library.

muse.viewingWebArtifacts.description: Displayed when the user is viewing web artifacts in the library.
